notes: Default estimation set: WH_EstimationExample.mat, 10 independent realizations x 8192 samples each, WITH dominant process noise (entering the system BEFORE the static nonlinearity -- see WienerHammersteinProcessNoise_description.md). Grouped into 5 folds of 2 realizations each for leave-one-fold-out CV.

Test: WH_TestDataset.mat, 2 columns = [multisine test, sine-sweep test], 16384 samples each, NOISELESS (process noise switched off for testing) -- reported SEPARATELY, never combined, per the official README's own instruction not to use this data during estimation.

The official zip's OTHER measurement-campaign files (a literature-standard 2-realization alternative estimation set, plus several additional recordings) are cached separately under data/ but NOT used by this project's default protocol -- see program.md for how to try them as explicit experiments.
